data.one_liner: CP949 and EUC-KR text encoder and decoder for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides encoding and decoding for the CP949 and EUC-KR character sets following the Dart standard Encoding protocol. It includes methods for decoding byte lists, encoding strings, and fixing incorrectly decoded strings.
use_when: You need to decode or encode CP949 or EUC-KR data in Dart or Flutter.
You want to handle legacy Korean text encodings with lower memory consumption.
avoid_when: You are running on a host endian other than Little Endian (host endian must be Little Endian for memory optimization to work properly).
You only need standard UTF-8 or Latin-1 encodings already supported by dart:convert.
strengths: Follows the standard Dart `Encoding` protocol from `dart:convert`.
Supports null safety and includes tests and examples.
weaknesses: Requires Little Endian architecture for its memory consumption optimization to work properly.
